title: Paloma and the Garden
author: Tamsin Vasquez
blurb: Beatrix Ravensworth, the last oath-bound swordspeaker, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
